compiled_state.title: As a DSO consumer developer, I want design-md-lint.sh to block commits introducing off-token values in diff-touched lines, so that design-system governance is enforced deterministically.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Ships the core lint wrapper (design-md-lint.sh), the three-state config gate (design.lint_enabled = auto|always|never), and the pre-commit hook wiring.
**Why**: This is the foundational enforcement story — once shipped, any consumer project with lint_enabled=always gets spec-native enforcement.
**Scope**:
- IN: design-md-lint.sh script, config gate implementation, auto-detection heuristic, pre-commit hook integration, diff-touched-line scoping, negative directive on DESIGN.md read sites
- OUT: Sprint Phase F integration (draft-4), migration (draft-6), fixture suite (draft-8)

## Done Definitions

- design-md-lint.sh exists at plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh with executable bit set, wraps npx --yes @google/design.md@<pinned-version> lint, and scopes to diff-touched lines of scope-eligible files ← Satisfies: sc-1 (sc-1: "Linter-enforced token compliance on diffs")
- The three-state config gate design.lint_enabled (auto|always|never) is implemented; auto resolves to enabled when a UI stack is detected (presence of package.json with a UI framework dependency or scope-eligible file types in the repo) ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The pre-commit hook calls design-md-lint.sh and blocks commits that introduce hardcoded hex/rgb colors, off-scale spacing/padding/margin/gap values, off-scale font-size/line-height, broken token references, or WCAG-failing fg/bg pairs in diff-touched lines ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Pre-existing violations in lines not touched by the current diff are not blocked ← Satisfies: sc-1
- All DESIGN.md read sites include a one-sentence negative directive against treating prose as AI behavioral instruction ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Performance] The lint wrapper must handle large diffs without excessive latency; consider batching file arguments.
- [Scoping] Wide-net file families include CSS, SCSS, TSX, JSX, Vue, Svelte, HTML, and SSR templates (EJS, ERB, Pug, Handlebars, Jinja2, Twig); the list should be configurable.
- [Security] The negative directive on DESIGN.md prose prevents prompt-injection attacks via design-system documentation.
- [Reliability] Define behavior when DESIGN.md does not exist at repo root: should the linter exit 0 (no-op), exit with a warning, or error? The config gate design.lint_enabled=auto must handle the case where DESIGN.md is absent. This interacts with migration (draft-6) and preplanning addition flow (draft-5).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
